Now I understand the vulnerability. The `cfg.mServiceData` is 252 bytes, but `cfg.mServiceDataLength` is set to `static_cast<uint8_t>(strlen(argv[2]))` which can be up to 255. So if we provide a service data of 253-255 bytes, we overflow the stack buffer.
